q: Which function counts missing values per column?
explain: isna() marks missing cells as True, and sum() adds them per column.

q: A histogram with a long tail on the right tells you the data is:
explain: A few large values stretch the distribution to the right.

options: To catch errors, outliers and missing values that would mislead a model
Because models cannot run without a plot
To avoid needing a test set
